bullets: • Distinguish "no qualifying data" (—) from "zero qualifying records" (0%).
• State one testable outcome per displayed column or conditional branch.
• Verify metric logic independent of data retrieval or filtering implementation.
• Define fallback message when dataset is entirely absent or empty.
• Specify sort order for null/missing metric values relative to numeric values.
• Use 'approve'/'reject' terminology; never 'pass'/'fail' for verdict fields.
• Round all percentages to nearest integer; suffix with '%'.
• Declare which data fields qualify for each metric's numerator and denominator.
